why_step_not_wbpz: wbpz is Ansys-version-locked and cannot be regenerated or reviewed; STEP is ASCII, opens in Workbench/SpaceClaim/DesignModeler/SolidWorks, and is rebuilt from this script.
carries: geometry only -- material, mesh, supports and loads come from each lab sheet's setup table

parts.description: Flat cantilever bracket: 120 x 40 x 6 mm plate, O12 mm hole 30 mm from the fixed edge.
Seven-member planar truss as line bodies; nodes A(0,0) B(3000,0) C(6000,0) D(1500,2000) E(4500,2000) mm.
notes: Assign the 20 x 20 mm square section in Mechanical: that assignment is the lesson.

parts.description: Stage A warm-up: 1.0 m simply supported beam as line bodies, split at midspan so the 50 N load has a vertex.
notes: Assign the 20 x 20 mm square section in DesignModeler, then Form New Part on both bodies.
Needs a Fixed Rotation (ROTX) as well as the simple supports: a straight beam can spin about its own axis.

parts.description: Plate with a central hole, solid: 100 x 40 x 5 mm, O10 mm centred.
Same plate as a planar surface body for the 2D plane-stress model (thickness 5 mm set in Mechanical).
Simply supported beam as a single 2000 mm line body; section assigned in Mechanical.
Same beam as a solid, pre-split into five bodies at the two 20 mm bearing strips and the 20 mm midspan load patch.
notes: Use Share Topology (SpaceClaim) or Form New Part (DesignModeler) so the segments mesh as one body.

parts.description: Cantilevered round post: O40 x 200 mm, axis along the length.
Stepped shaft O32x50 -> O25x100 with a 2 mm shoulder fillet and an end-milled keyseat 8 wide x 4.0 deep x 32 long, bottom fillet r = 0.5 mm (r/d = 0.02).
Thick-walled cylinder, 2D axisymmetric half-section: r 50-80 mm, 50 mm long.
Press fit, 2D axisymmetric: shaft drawn to R = 25.05 mm, hub bore 25.00 mm, hub OD 100 mm. The 0.05 mm overlap IS the interference.
notes: Do not let contact 'adjust to touch' -- that deletes the interference this lab measures.

parts.description: 5 degree wedge of the same cylinder for pairs who prefer a 3D model.
Preloaded bolted joint: two 100 x 60 x 12 mm plates with 11 mm clearance holes, M10 bolt as O10 shank with O16 x 8 head and nut.
Slender column: O12 x 1000 mm, perfectly straight (eigenvalue-buckling case).
Same column with a 2 mm half-sine midspan bow (~L/500) as the geometric imperfection for the large-deflection run.
Exam 3 SD column template: O25 x 1200 mm round column, the SB tie rod. Replaces the exam3_column_template.SLDPRT the paper named and the repo never had.
